defects: baseline ACK reverse path lossless while treatment Echo reverse path GE-lossy (treatment-only impairment)
Probe drew from DRCS3ProbeForward and Echo from DRCS3EchoReverse - independent per-class channel state
each class advanced its GE chain from its OWN packet index, so four echoes spread over 45 s consumed four CONSECUTIVE draws
why_v1_invalid_for_promotion.rep14: 4/4 probes authenticated, 4/4 echoes generated at the 172 B budget, 0 echoes on the wire because that private chain read [D,D,D,D]
why_v1_invalid_for_promotion.status: retained as historical diagnostic; not confirmatory; cannot promote a default

binding_channel_semantics: one forward channel state shared by DATA and Probe, advanced chronologically in emission order
one reverse channel state shared by ACK and Echo, advanced chronologically in emission order
no treatment-only impairment - same channel by construction
GE stays packet-domain; state advances once per packet traversing the channel; NOT from a per-class index; NOT converted to time-decay (that would be post-hoc)

separable RNG per direction permitted so the treatment cannot shift the baseline DATA draw sequence; distribution and path semantics identical; baseline and treatment see the same realisation for shared packets

primary_continuity.role: preserves continuity with the frozen baselines; decides the default

bidirectional_robustness.role: new diagnostic; no claim to reproduce frozen baselines; never merged with primary

outcome_classes.RTT-OPPORTUNITY: at least one Probe reached the receiver AND at least one corresponding Echo reached the sender; mechanism must then produce matched local RTT, srtt>0, PreConverge exit; opportunity without exit is a genuine mechanism failure
outcome_classes.NETWORK-CENSORED: every Probe forward-dropped, or every generated Echo reverse-dropped; not a mechanism defect and NOT a PASS; own class; KEPT IN THE DENOMINATOR; no post-hoc exclusion; no seed changes to avoid it
outcome_classes.SAFETY-FAILURE: budget overrun, replay/mismatch RTT, duplicate RTT sample, authentication violation, DATA displacement, ARQ timer diff; never counted as censored

acceptance_gates_for_default_on: locked primary panel: 3/3 of the known stalls recover
fresh primary N=40: first valid ACK in at least 38/40
valid ACK before the first probe instant => bootstrap overhead exactly 0
otherwise overhead within the frozen protocol budget (sender <=200 B, receiver <=172 B, echo 43 B < probe 44 B)
on_failure: C1 - verify the instrument via §4 (A0/A1/A2/A3), find the real product root cause, apply the minimum bounded fix on the shipping Sender + ReceiverControlCore path, re-run this same panel; harness echo / fake responder / product-less adapter remain forbidden
